thesis: TSM is expected to classify as a Compounder with exceptional structural leadership, moat, reinvestment economics and financial survival, offset by a current price about 15% above locked Base value and moderate asymmetry. The correct posture is not aggressive value buying but a normal candidate position paced by valuation and macro/geopolitical uncertainty.

evidence.claim: 2Q26 gross margin 67.7%, operating margin 60.3% and advanced-node mix 77%.

counterevidence: Current valuation already discounts substantial AI/HPC durability.
Overseas fab economics and customer/geopolitical concentration cap position size.
falsifiers: If calibrated MT/RF/MA/FS fail Compounder thresholds or a Hard Veto becomes unresolved/confirmed, sizing should fall to watch/0%.
